video.title: UX Group Feedback: Threaded discussions (GitLab Unfiltered)

project_context:
# Project context: GitLab comment threads redesign

The recording is a public GitLab UX team call ("UX Group Feedback: Threaded discussions", GitLab Unfiltered on YouTube). A product designer screen-shares a visual redesign of the threaded discussion and comment UI that appears on GitLab issues and merge requests, and teammates react and give feedback.

Treat the presenting designer as the delivery team and the other participants' spoken reactions, requests, concerns, and questions as the feedback to triage. The product is GitLab's web UI, specifically discussion threads: comments, replies, resolving threads, avatars, timestamps, and related controls.

The redesign is a work-in-progress mockup, so feedback about the mockup itself is in scope. General conversation, meeting logistics, and the presenter's own explanation of the design are not change requests.

analysis.summary: Marcel presents a redesign of discussion threads and replies on merge requests and issues, simplifying borders and improving layout. Teammates discuss visual redundancy of the 'commented' label, hover actions, indentation, and mobile view alignment.

results.title: Show action icons on hover
results.summary: Shane asks why action icons on comments are always visible instead of appearing on hover, considering pages have a lot of content.
results.requested_outcome: Show comment action icons only when hovering over a particular comment.

evidence.client_quote: Why can't it be that when I hover over a particular comment, then I see the action icons... like do we need them always visible like that?

results.rationale: Shane explicitly questions the constant visibility of comment action icons and proposes showing them on hover.
results.route_description: Ready for an explicit Approval decision.
